{{Quote|Gareth, take care of your mother. Mera, I love you. I'm sorry|TK329's last words to his family|<ref name="Last words">{{Twitter|TK329|status/4821940216|[[TK 329]]|date=2009-10-12|archivedate=20211121033338}}</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|woman]] named '''Mera''' was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[TK 329]]. The two had a son named [[Gareth (TK 329's son)|Gareth]]<ref name="ItsAGirl" /> by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="DT">''[[Death Troopers]]'' places the ''Vector'' outbreak in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Mera's husband was exposed to a [[Death/Legends|fatal]] contagion<ref name="Mera">{{Twitter|TK329|status/4836069723|[[TK 329]]|quote=I can feel the death coursing through my body. It wonnnnt b lonng now.|archivedate=20200813150402}}</ref> called the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]]<ref name="DTalone">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref> while serving aboard the Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']].<ref name="ItsAGirl" /> At the time of the outbreak, TK 329 planned on having a big party for his shoreleave home, and he believed that his wife and son supported him in his mission.<ref name="Mera" /> Shortly before his death,<ref name="DT" /> TK 329 transmitted an open message hoping it would reach his family. In it, he told Gareth to take care of Mera in his absence and let Mera know that he loved them.<ref name="Last words" /> The stormtrooper also announced his plans to escape with a group of survivors, but the sickness took him first.<ref name="Mera" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mera was mentioned in three [[Wikipedia:Twitter|tweets]] from TK 329's [[in-universe]] [[Stormtrooper TK 329 (TK329) on Twitter|Twitter account]]. The account was created in [[2009]] as a tie-in to the then-upcoming novel ''[[Death Troopers]]'', written by [[Joe Schreiber]].<ref name="Mera" />
